examples.label: Pipe the nmap XML into aquatone to screenshot + cluster hosts

notes: Same idea as EyeWitness - it clusters visually similar pages, which quickly reveals templated login panels across many vhosts. Needs the Chromium/headless dependency present.
name: Aquatone - Visual Web Inspection
description: Alternative screenshotting tool; ingests Nmap XML and builds an HTML report of every web host for quick visual triage.

defense.why_it_works: Aquatone issues HTTP/HTTPS requests to a list of URLs and screenshots the rendered page, aggregating results into an HTML report enabling rapid visual identification of live web applications without manual browsing.
defense.prerequisites: A list of candidate URLs or subdomains. Network access to targets on HTTP/HTTPS ports.
defense.impact: Attacker visually surveys dozens of applications simultaneously, identifying login panels, default dashboards, and exposed management interfaces.
defense.detection: Single source IP makes sequential HTTP GET requests to many hosts/ports in a short window. Identical User-Agent string (aquatone) across many requests. IDS can alert on the Aquatone User-Agent signature.
defense.artifacts: Web server access logs (sequential HEAD/GET from one IP) | IDS alerts for reconnaissance User-Agent strings | DNS query logs showing mass subdomain resolution
defense.prevention: Block unauthenticated access to management endpoints via ACL. Require authentication before serving login pages to unrecognised IPs. Use WAF rules to block known recon tool User-Agents.
defense.misconfiguration: All web application management panels are publicly reachable with no authentication gate, enabling visual recon without any credentials.
defense.evasion: Throttle and randomize the screenshot/probe sweep; use a normal User-Agent; scope to in-scope hosts to avoid a fan-out pattern.
